etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 王 (phonetic オウ) — sunlight at royal strength: vigorous, flourishing.
mnemonic: The sun on the throne — オウ. 旺盛: appetite and energy at full blaze.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 区 (phonetic オウ) + 殳 'striking arm' — blows delivered: to beat.
mnemonic: The striking arm let loose in the ward — なぐる. 殴る: the police-report verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 公 (phonetic オウ) + 羽 — the white-feathered elder: venerable old man.
mnemonic: Down-white hair like feathers — おきな. The Noh stage's oldest mask.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 意 (phonetic オク) — thoughts kept in the heart: to remember.
mnemonic: The heart's archive room — オク. 記憶: memory, filed under feeling.

etymology: Pictograph: a bent hook or sprouting shoot — the second of the old ordinal signs (甲乙丙): the latter; quaint charm (乙な).
mnemonic: The runner-up's curly ribbon — オツ. 甲乙つけがたい: too close to rank.

etymology: Compound: unloading goods from the cart (the root of 御す) — goods set down in bulk: wholesale.
mnemonic: Crates set down before the shop opens — おろす. 卸売: selling by the pallet.

etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + a phonetic — the harvest safely in, the heart at rest: calm, mild.
mnemonic: Granary full, hands folded — おだやか. 穏やかな海: the sea off duty.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 圭 'ritual jade' (phonetic カ) — fine as ceremonial jade: excellent.
mnemonic: A person cut like a gem — カ. 佳作: the prize just under the prize.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the woman (女) entering the house (家) — the bride; to marry into.
mnemonic: 女 + 家: the wedding in one glyph — よめ. 花嫁: the bride in bloom.

etymology: Compound: the household head left divided under the roof — bereft: widowed; reduced: few (寡黙).
mnemonic: One chair now empty under the roof — カ. 寡黙: words gone few.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sun/day (日) + 叚 'borrowed' (phonetic カ) — days on loan from duty: leisure.
mnemonic: Borrowed daylight, no agenda — ひま. 暇なとき: the loan everyone wants extended.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 加 'add' (phonetic カ) + wood (木) — timber added across: to span, to shelve.
mnemonic: Beams added between banks — かける. 架け橋: the bridging kanji, literal and diplomatic.

etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 咼 (phonetic カ) — misfortune sent from beyond: calamity.
mnemonic: The altar's dark invoice — わざわい. コロナ禍: the suffix of bad years.

etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 家 (phonetic カ) — bringing the harvest home: to earn.
mnemonic: Grain carried through your own gate — かせぐ. 稼ぐ: the paycheck verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo tallies (⺮) + 固 (phonetic カ) — one bamboo tally per item: the counter 箇/ヶ.
mnemonic: One stick per thing — カ. 三箇月 or 3ヶ月: same tally, shrunk.

etymology: Pictograph: a plant in full cascade of blossom — flowering splendor; also China (中華).
mnemonic: 花's gala outfit — はな, カ. 豪華: luxury in bloom; 中華: the flowering middle kingdom.

etymology: Phono-semantic: insect (虫) + 文 (phonetic ブン — the whine ぶーん) — the humming biter: mosquito.
mnemonic: The bug that writes (文) itchy notes on your arm — か. 蚊取り線香: the green spiral counterattack.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 牙 (phonetic ガ) + bird (隹) — originally a crow-name, borrowed for courtly refinement: elegant.
mnemonic: The bird that behaves at court — みやび. 優雅: grace with a pedigree.

etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 我 (phonetic ガ) — the self stripped to hunger: to starve.
mnemonic: When 'I' and 'food' are the only two thoughts left — ガ. 餓死: hunger's last entry.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 鬼 (phonetic カイ) — a mass of earth: clod, lump.
mnemonic: A ghost-shaped fistful of dirt — かたまり. 塊: gold nuggets and cheese chunks alike.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + a phonetic — walls brought down: to break, destroy.
mnemonic: The wall returns to dirt — こわす. 破壊: demolition, budgeted.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + a phonetic — the heart's prickle at the uncanny: strange, suspect.
mnemonic: The shiver before the ghost story starts — あやしい. 怪物, 妖怪: mystery's staff directory.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 毎 (phonetic カイ) — the heart replaying it every time: regret.
mnemonic: Every (毎) night the heart reruns the tape — くやしい. 後悔: hindsight with teeth.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + a phonetic — what's carried against the chest: the bosom pocket; what the chest carries longest: nostalgia.
mnemonic: The inside pocket over the heart — ふところ, なつかしい. 懐かしい: warmth from the old pocket.

etymology: Compound ideograph: both hands on the halberd (戈) — on guard: to admonish, warn; the precepts kept.
mnemonic: Weapon held at ready as a rule of life — カイ. 警戒: the guard posture, institutional.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — taken away by force or trick: to abduct.
mnemonic: The hand that leads someone the wrong way — カイ. 誘拐: the crime-drama kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 亥 (phonetic ガイ) + 力 — force brought against an official's misdeeds: impeachment.
mnemonic: Muscle applied to a minister — ガイ. 弾劾: the impeachment headline.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 既 'already' (phonetic ガイ) — the heart sighing over what's already done: lament.
mnemonic: Too late, and the heart knows it — ガイ. 感慨: the long exhale at anniversaries.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 既 (phonetic ガイ) — the leveling stick drawn across a measure: the rough whole: outline.
mnemonic: The plank that levels the details away — ガイ. 概要: the gist, planed smooth.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 厓 'cliff-edge' (phonetic ガイ) — where the water meets its edge: the bound, the horizon.
mnemonic: The waterline of a life — ガイ. 生涯: from first shore to last.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 亥 (phonetic ガイ) — the item the text points at: the said, relevant.
mnemonic: The legal finger pointing back up the page — ガイ. 該当: 'applies to you'.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 亘 (phonetic エン→かき) — the low earthen wall: hedge, fence.
mnemonic: The waist-high wall neighbors chat over — かき. 垣根: the polite boundary.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 赫 'blazing red' (phonetic カク) — a scarlet-faced roar: to menace.
mnemonic: Two fires' worth of shouting — カク. 威嚇: the growl before the bite.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 亥 (phonetic カク) — the fruit's stone: kernel, core; the atom's: nucleus.
mnemonic: The pit inside the peach, the core inside the atom — カク. 核心: the middle of the middle.

etymology: Compound: the hard casing struck (殳) away — husk, shell.
mnemonic: What cracks off and gets swept up — から. 貝殻: the beach's confetti.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hound (犭) + 蒦 (phonetic カク) — the hunting dog's catch: to seize, win.
mnemonic: The retriever returns with the prize — える. 獲得: points, titles, territory.

etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 蒦 (phonetic カク) — the grain version of 獲: to reap.
mnemonic: 獲's farming twin — カク. 収穫: the year's catch, in sheaves.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 享 (phonetic カク) + city (阝) — the walled outer town: enclosure, quarter.
mnemonic: The city's outer ring wall — カク. 輪郭: the outline — a face's city wall.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wall (阝) + 鬲 (phonetic カク) — a partition between: to separate; every other (隔週).
mnemonic: The wall that makes two rooms of one — へだてる. 隔離: separation, medical grade.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a hill (丘) stacked on a mountain (山) — the high peak.
mnemonic: Mountain with a mountain on top — たけ. 山岳: alpine country; 岳父: the father-in-law summit.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 卦 (phonetic カイ→か) — hung by hand: to hang, to set upon.
mnemonic: Hooked up by hand — かける. 腰掛け, 掛け算, 声を掛ける: Japanese hangs everything on this verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 曷 (phonetic カツ) — the sharp bark of rebuke: to scold; Zen's waking shout.
mnemonic: The master's one-syllable thunder — カツ. 喝!: enlightenment, or at least attention.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — drawn together and tied: to bundle, bracket.
mnemonic: Everything cinched in one tie — カツ. 一括: paid in one bundle; 括弧: brackets, the typographic string.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 曷 (phonetic カツ) — water run out: thirst, drying up.
mnemonic: The canteen's hollow slosh — かわく. 渇き: thirst, literal or ambitious.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 骨 (phonetic カツ) — wet bone-smooth: slippery; to glide.
mnemonic: Wet bones underfoot: skating guaranteed — すべる. 滑走路: the runway, professionally slippery.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 曷 (phonetic カツ) — the coarse hemp cloak's color: brown.
mnemonic: The beggar's cloak shade — カツ. 褐色: tan, in formalwear.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 害 (phonetic カツ) — the linchpin that keeps the wheel on: control, jurisdiction.
mnemonic: Pull the pin and the cart is nobody's — カツ. 管轄: whose pin it is.

etymology: Pictograph: offerings stacked on a stand — one atop another: moreover, furthermore.
mnemonic: And another layer on the pile — かつ. 且つ: the conjunction shaped like its meaning.
